romanized_text:
ek vidyalay men varshik vijnana pradarshani ayojit ki j rahi thi. is bar chatron ko ais mdala banan tha jo kisi vastavik samasy k samadhan prastut kare.

nain aur usake mitron ne ek smart robot banane k nirnay liya. unak vichar tha ki robot bujaurg logon ki dainik gatividhiyon men sahayat kara sake. unhonne kai saptah tak dijain taiyar kiya, programing ki aur vibhinn sensar jodae.

pradarshani ke din robot ne agantukon k svagat kiya, davaiyon ki yad dilane k pradarshan kiya aur avashyakat padane para sahayat sandesh bhejane ki kshamat bhi dikhai. logon ko yaha pariyojan bahut pasand ai.

nirnayak mandal ne chatron se kai takaniki prashn puche. nain aur usaki tim ne atmavishvas ke sath sabhi prashnon ke uttar die. unhonne batay ki bhavishy men ve robot men svasthy nigarani ki suvidh bhi jodana chahate hain.

din ke ant men unaki pariyojan ko pratham puraskar mil. puraskar se adhik khushi unhen is bat ki thi ki unak vichar samaj ke lie upayogi sabit ho sakat hai.

key_events: An annual science exhibition is being organized at a school.
Students are tasked to create a model that offers a solution to a real-world problem.
event_chain.scene_goal: Establish the setting of the science exhibition and introduce the students' assignment to design a problem‑solving model.
event_chain.narrative_link: Following the opening of the story, the school now organizes the annual science exhibition and assigns the students their project.

key_events: The students decide to build a smart robot intended to assist elderly people in daily activities.
They spend several weeks designing the robot, programming it, and attaching various sensors.
event_chain.scene_goal: Demonstrate the students' initiative and collaborative effort to create a functional robot for elderly assistance.
event_chain.location: Workshop or lab where the students work on the robot
event_chain.narrative_link: Following the establishment of the science exhibition setting and the assignment to design a problem‑solving model, the students now decide to create a smart robot to help elderly people.

key_events: The robot welcomed the visitors on the exhibition day
It demonstrated a medicine reminder display
It showed the capability to send assistance messages when needed
The audience expressed strong appreciation for the project
event_chain.scene_goal: To showcase the robot's functionalities and gain public approval for the elderly‑assistance project
event_chain.location: Exhibition venue during the demonstration day
event_chain.narrative_link: Following the students' initiative and collaborative effort to create a functional robot for elderly assistance, the robot now demonstrates its capabilities to visitors

key_events: The decision committee asks the students several technical questions.
Nain and his team confidently answer all the questions.
They state that in the future they want to add health‑monitoring capabilities to the robot.
event_chain.scene_goal: To demonstrate technical competence and propose an additional health‑monitoring feature, thereby building public approval for the elderly‑assistance project.
event_chain.narrative_link: Following the demonstration of the robot's functionalities, the decision committee now asks technical questions.

key_events: At the end of the day their project receives its first award.
They feel even greater happiness because their idea could prove useful to society.
event_chain.scene_goal: To show external recognition of the project and deepen the characters' confidence that their work benefits the community.
event_chain.narrative_link: Following the demonstration of technical competence and the proposal of a health‑monitoring feature, the team now receives their first award.
